title: Add sha2 and thiserror to workspace Cargo.toml
description:
What: Add sha2 and thiserror workspace deps, and pre-populate kith-core lib.rs module structure.

Algorithm:
1. Edit /home/mark/WORK/KITH/Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies]: add
   sha2 = "0.10"
   thiserror = "1"
2. Edit /home/mark/WORK/KITH/crates/kith-core/Cargo.toml [dependencies]: add
   sha2.workspace = true
   thiserror.workspace = true
3. Write /home/mark/WORK/KITH/crates/kith-core/src/lib.rs with exactly:
   pub mod auth;
   pub mod chat;
   pub mod contact;
   pub mod error;
   pub mod jmap;
   pub mod message;
   pub mod resultref;
   (Each module file will be created by its respective implementation bead.)
4. Create stub files for each module so cargo check passes:
   For each of: auth, chat, contact, error, jmap, message, resultref
   Write src/<name>.rs containing a single comment: // TODO: implement
5. Run: cargo check -p kith-core
6. Verify sha2 and thiserror appear in Cargo.lock

Defensive programming rules:
- Use exact major version pins (sha2 = "0.10", thiserror = "1")
- Do not add any features beyond what is needed

Agent team: single Implementer agent.

Tests: cargo check -p kith-core exits 0.
